g.text: Electrical load models used by the core benchmarks

text.style: font-size: 7.7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #68737d

g.text: Each load is a named-reference-plane one-port; geometry, plasma state and species-power partition remain outside scope.
Scope: A4 checks the series CCP terminal form; A5 checks the identifiable ICP reduction.
ICP transformer lineage: Lee et al. (2020), DOI 10.1063/1.5133862.
